items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Smith, I can't think of his first name.... He was a (?) trumpet player. He didn't stay in the band long.

ctx.x: one of the trumpet players would lose his lip or he'd get like physical problems?

Yeah, yeah. Well, we had two or three around then. Let me see. Smith, I can't think of his first name.... He was a (?) trumpet player. He didn't stay in the band long. He died, too. Good trumpet player. Now, he's right on with a (?)whole list(?) of boys. That Joe Keyes and Hot Lips, Leroy White, they was all in good health, all the time. Yeah. All the time.
I mean, apparently Hot Lips used to take ten or fifteen choruses all the time.
